formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 x2 : ℕ) (x3 : Fin x1 → Fin x2) (x4 x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack x1 x4 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x5 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack x2 x5 → ∃ (x10 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x10 ∧ x10.size ≤ x4.size + x5.size + (1 : ℕ) ∧ ∀ (x11 : Fin x2 → Bool), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x2 x10 x11 = ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x4 fun (x12 : Fin x1) => x11 (x3 x12)) || PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x2 x5 x11))
plain_statement: It is false that: If C1 is an AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two on n1 inputs, C2 one on n2 inputs (both reading earlier wires), and r maps the n1 inputs into the n2, then some AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two with at most size(C1) + size(C2) + 1 gates computes C1 applied to the inputs picked by r, OR C2.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Search: an order-3 plane circuit of at most 63 fan-in-two AND/OR gates, true at incident pairs, false at every degenerate maxim
